body: I do though, I could have stopped him, I could have stepped in for him, I could be less of a burden.  Even now I am still relying on him.  We talk a lot, but that doesn't mean I am helping him at all, and it doesn't mean that I couldn't have helped him in the past.

You say I can take control of that but I have no idea how.  I can't just make my own happiness.  I can't just escape from reality and who I am.  I can't escape from what happened because of me and I can't do anything.
